brief: Points at one element of a parsed HTML document and reads its tag, text, id, class and attributes.
detail: A handle is the document, a tag name and the rank of the element among elements of that tag. It is made by Find, FindFirst, Elements and ElementsWhere of stzHtml. The document is read-only, so a node cannot change anything.
receiver:
d1 = new stzHtml('
link
') o1 = d1.FindFirst("#main")
